Here's a summary of what I know about Harry Bush, the English cricketer:

- Harry Bush was an English first-class cricketer who played in the late 19th century.

- He played domestic cricket for Gloucestershire County Cricket Club between 1890 and 1899.

- Bush was a right-handed batsman and occasional wicket-keeper.

- In his 10-year first-class career, he played 85 matches for Gloucestershire, scoring 2,693 runs at an average of 20.53.

- His highest first-class score was 98 runs. 

- Bush did not represent England at the international level, playing his entire career at the county level for Gloucestershire.

- He is considered one of the better batsmen to have played for Gloucestershire during the late Victorian era of English cricket.

- Beyond these basic facts about his domestic cricket career, I don't have any additional detailed information about Harry Bush's life or playing style that I'm completely confident is accurate. My knowledge about this historical cricketer is fairly limited.
